items.title: Alfred Williams Interview, 1960-04-30
items.q: Well, sometime he had old man Kimball on bass. Kimball's father. Yeah. Yeah, he and him. He worked for him a long time.

ctx.x: Something like that? Or was it Lawson?

No, Harvey Lightfoot. Harvey Lightfoot. Yeah, that's his name. He's on record, too. Yeah. Harvey, wait. Is he still living? I don't know. Harvey Lightfoot. Mm-hmm. And he had a drummer. What's his drummer name? He live in Chicago. Now, a singing drummer. He sings well. Camel. Oh, yes. Camel. Floyd. That's right. Floyd Camel. That's right. He on piano. And, uh, what's this trombone player name? Natty Dominic? Nat, Nat, Nat, Nat. Nat, Nat. A trombone. Fine trombone. That's him. That's right. That story. St. Louis.…
I think before Andy came in, you were telling about when you played up the roof garden and Fates band.
